claimText: The campus includes academic buildings, a learning centre, laboratories, Wi-Fi, a cafeteria and a cooperative store. Laundry, ATMs and reverse-osmosis water facilities support day-to-day campus living.

The teaching campus is on the Sathy–Bhavani State Highway at Alathukombai, Sathyamangalam, in Erode district, Tamil Nadu 638401. Sathyamangalam is the canonical town; Erode is the district rather than a substitute campus city. TNEA counselling identifies the college with code 2702.
Undergraduate Regulations 2026 include laboratory work, projects, employability-enhancement activities and industry-oriented courses.
internalNotes: MBA internship and ME dissertation components are supported by separate evidence entries; no placement guarantee is asserted.

claimText: Separate men’s and women’s hostels provide single, double and four-person room options. Hostel dining halls, kitchens and storage facilities are available. Room allocation and current hostel and mess charges require a separate accommodation budget.

Hostel dining halls and a campus cafeteria provide meal facilities. The verified information does not specify allergy provision or every dietary option; these requirements should be discussed before accepting accommodation.
The campus medical centre has resident medical officers, nursing staff and a round-the-clock emergency ambulance service for access to hospitals in Sathyamangalam, Coimbatore or Erode.

Undergraduate students are assigned a faculty mentor for course registration, academic progression and career objectives. Students Traffic can help compare the admission route, branch and full-cost plan.
Anna University lists Bannari Amman Institute of Technology (Autonomous) with TNEA 2702 and examination code 7376.
The UGC-DTBU page is an application-document collection, not an approval conferring deemed-to-be-university status.
MBA regulations specify a four-week summer internship and final-semester project.
ME programmes include third- and fourth-semester dissertation phases.
No reliable current category-specific annual tuition is established. Conflicting full-course secondary totals must not be annualised.
internalNotes: See second independently read fee source.
